en.t: Whichever it is, it will be cut off at once.

units.source_text: 即使你认定强要让它持续下去，它还会在不知不觉间中断的。

en.t: Even if you decide to force it to continue, it will still be cut off before you know it.

units.source_text: 火车疾驰的时候，乘客是静止的。

en.t: When the train is racing along, the passengers are still.

units.source_text: 火车一停，乘客就一定会从车厢里走出来。

en.t: Once the train stops, the passengers are sure to come out of the carriage.

units.source_text: 疾驰中断，休息也将中断。

en.t: When the racing rush is interrupted, the rest will be interrupted as well.

units.source_text: 死虽是最终的休息，但也不知会持续到什么时候。"

en.t: Death may be the final rest, but even that cannot be known how long it will last.
